source.text: וַיַּֽעַשׂ־ל֥וֹ בָתִּ֖ים בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיָּ֤כֶן מָקוֹם֙ לַֽאֲר֣וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֶּט־ל֖וֹ אֹֽהֶל׃

records.literal_gloss: And made for himself houses in [the] city of David, and prepared a place for [the] ark of the God, and pitched for it a tent.

en.L: And he made houses for himself in the city of David, and he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
en.B: David built houses for himself in the city of David. He also prepared a place for the ark of God, and he pitched a tent for it.
en.R: David built houses for himself in the city of David. He also got a place ready for the ark of God and set up a tent for it.

es.L: E hizo para sí casas en la ciudad de David, y preparó un lugar para el arca de Dios, y le levantó una tienda.
es.B: David se construyó casas en la ciudad de David. También preparó un lugar para el arca de Dios y levantó una tienda para ella.
es.R: David se construyó casas en la ciudad de David. También dejó listo un lugar para el arca de Dios y armó una tienda para ella.

fr.L: Et il se fit des maisons dans la cité de David, et il prépara un lieu pour l’arche de Dieu, et il dressa pour elle une tente.
fr.B: David se construisit des maisons dans la cité de David. Il prépara aussi un lieu pour l’arche de Dieu, et il dressa une tente pour elle.
fr.R: David s’est construit des maisons dans la cité de David. Il a aussi préparé un endroit pour l’arche de Dieu, et il a monté une tente pour elle.

sw.L: Akajijengea nyumba katika mji wa Daudi, akaandaa mahali kwa ajili ya sanduku la Mungu, akalipigia hema.
sw.B: Daudi alijijengea nyumba katika mji wa Daudi. Pia akaandaa mahali kwa ajili ya sanduku la Mungu, akalipigia hema.
sw.R: Daudi alijijengea nyumba katika mji wa Daudi. Pia akatayarisha mahali kwa ajili ya sanduku la Mungu, akalisimamishia hema.

vi.L: Ông xây nhà cho mình trong thành Đa-vít, và ông chuẩn bị một chỗ cho hòm của Đức Chúa Trời và dựng một cái lều cho hòm.
vi.B: Đa-vít xây nhà cho mình trong thành Đa-vít. Ông cũng chuẩn bị một chỗ cho hòm của Đức Chúa Trời và dựng một cái lều cho hòm.
vi.R: Đa-vít xây nhà cho mình trong thành Đa-vít. Ông cũng sửa soạn một chỗ cho hòm của Đức Chúa Trời và dựng một cái lều cho hòm.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 다윗 성에 자기를 위하여 집들을 지었고, 하나님의 궤를 위하여 장소를 마련하고 그것을 위하여 장막을 쳤다.
ko.B: 다윗은 다윗 성에 자기가 살 집들을 지었다. 또 하나님의 궤를 둘 곳을 마련하고 그것을 위하여 장막을 쳤다.
ko.R: 다윗은 다윗 성에 자기가 살 집들을 지었다. 또 하나님의 궤를 둘 곳을 준비하고, 그 궤를 위해 장막을 쳤다.

decisions.choice: he: David
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject; it carries on from chapter 14, where David is settled in Jerusalem and Hiram of Tyre builds him a house (14:1-2).

decisions.choice: houses in the city of David: buildings for the king and his household
decisions.reason: The city of David was the stronghold of Zion that David had taken and named after himself (11:5-7). "Houses" may mean the rooms and buildings of his palace and those for his growing family (14:3).

decisions.choice: a tent for the ark: a new tent in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: David prepares a place and sets up a tent for the ark in his own city, as 2 Samuel 6:17 also says. It is not the old tent of meeting, which stayed at Gibeon (16:39; 21:29). After three months at the house of Obed-Edom (13:14), the ark now has a place ready for it.

decisions.choice: David built
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name David as the subject, and use "built" for the general verb "made", since houses are meant.

source.text: אָ֚ז אָמַ֣ר דָּוִ֔יד לֹ֤א לָשֵׂאת֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֖י אִם־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם כִּי־בָ֣ם׀בָּחַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לָשֵׂ֞את אֶת־אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה וּֽלְשָׁרְת֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Then said David, Not to carry the ark of the God except the Levites, for them chose Yahweh to carry [the] ark of Yahweh and to serve him until forever.

en.L: Then David said, "[No one is] to carry the ark of God except the Levites, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} chose them to carry the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} forever."
en.B: Then David said, "No one may carry the ark of God except the Levites, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} chose them to carry the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} forever."
en.R: Then David said, "Only the Levites may carry the ark of God. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} chose them to carry the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for all time."

es.L: Entonces dijo David: «[Nadie] ha de llevar el arca de Dios sino los levitas, porque a ellos escogió {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} para llevar el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y para servirle para siempre».
es.B: Entonces David dijo: «Nadie puede llevar el arca de Dios sino los levitas, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los escogió a ellos para llevar el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y para servirle para siempre».
es.R: Entonces David dijo: «Solo los levitas pueden llevar el arca de Dios. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los escogió para llevar el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y para servirle por todos los tiempos».

fr.L: Alors David dit : « [Personne ne doit] porter l’arche de Dieu, sinon les Lévites, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les a choisis, eux, pour porter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir à jamais. »
fr.B: Alors David dit : « Personne ne doit porter l’arche de Dieu, sauf les Lévites, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les a choisis pour porter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir à jamais. »
fr.R: Alors David a dit : « Seuls les Lévites ont le droit de porter l’arche de Dieu. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les a choisis pour porter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servir pour toujours. »

sw.L: Ndipo Daudi akasema, "[Hakuna mtu] wa kulibeba sanduku la Mungu isipokuwa Walawi, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwachagua wao kulibeba sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumtumikia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} milele."
sw.B: Ndipo Daudi akasema, "Hakuna mtu anayeruhusiwa kulibeba sanduku la Mungu isipokuwa Walawi, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwachagua wao kulibeba sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumtumikia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} milele."
sw.R: Ndipo Daudi akasema, "Ni Walawi tu wanaoweza kulibeba sanduku la Mungu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwachagua wao kulibeba sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumtumikia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} siku zote."

vi.L: Bấy giờ Đa-vít nói: "[Không ai được] khiêng hòm của Đức Chúa Trời ngoại trừ người Lê-vi, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn họ để khiêng hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến đời đời."
vi.B: Bấy giờ Đa-vít nói: "Không ai được khiêng hòm của Đức Chúa Trời ngoại trừ người Lê-vi, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn họ để khiêng hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời."
vi.R: Bấy giờ Đa-vít nói: "Chỉ người Lê-vi mới được khiêng hòm của Đức Chúa Trời. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chọn họ để khiêng hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mãi mãi."

ko.L: 그때 다윗이 말했다. "레위인들 외에는 [아무도] 하나님의 궤를 메지 못한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 택하셔서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 메고 영원히 그분을 섬기게 하셨기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그때 다윗이 말했다. "레위인들 말고는 아무도 하나님의 궤를 멜 수 없다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 택하셔서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 메고 영원히 그분을 섬기게 하셨기 때문이다."
ko.R: 그때 다윗이 말했다. "레위인들만 하나님의 궤를 멜 수 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 뽑으셔서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 메고 언제까지나 그분을 섬기게 하셨다."

decisions.choice: chose them to carry the ark and to serve him: the Levites' task in the law
decisions.reason: David repeats what Deuteronomy 10:8 says: the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant and to stand before him to serve him. Numbers 1:50 and 4:15 give the carrying of the holy things to the Levites. On the first attempt the ark had been set on a cart (13:7), and Uzzah died (13:9-10); David now sees what went wrong (verse 13).

decisions.choice: not to carry ... except the Levites: a rule, no one else may carry it
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "not to carry" with no subject, a short way of stating a rule. "Except" makes clear who alone may do it.

decisions.choice: to serve him forever: to minister to the LORD for all time
decisions.reason: The verb is used of service in worship by priests and Levites. "Him" is the LORD, as in Deuteronomy 10:8. "Forever" means the appointment is lasting, not for this one journey only.

decisions.choice: [No one is]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the subject the Hebrew leaves out, so the rule can be read as a sentence.

decisions.choice: David's command in the plain style (해라체), with "그분" for God
decisions.reason: A king's ruling given to his people; the respect for God is carried by "그분" and the honorific, since Korean has no deity_pronoun span (the Korean style guide, section 7).

source.text: וַיַּקְהֵ֥ל דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְהַעֲלוֹת֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־מְקוֹמ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁר־הֵכִ֥ין לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And assembled David all Israel to Jerusalem to bring up [the] ark of Yahweh to its place which he had prepared for it.

en.L: And David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem to bring up the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to its place, which he had prepared for it.
en.B: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem to bring the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} up to the place he had prepared for it.
en.R: David called all Israel together in Jerusalem to bring the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} up to the place he had made ready for it.

es.L: Y reunió David a todo Israel en Jerusalén para subir el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a su lugar, que él le había preparado.
es.B: David reunió a todo Israel en Jerusalén para subir el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} al lugar que le había preparado.
es.R: David convocó a todo Israel en Jerusalén para subir el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} al lugar que le había dejado listo.

fr.L: Et David rassembla tout Israël à Jérusalem pour faire monter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à son lieu, qu’il avait préparé pour elle.
fr.B: David rassembla tout Israël à Jérusalem pour faire monter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} au lieu qu’il avait préparé pour elle.
fr.R: David a réuni tout Israël à Jérusalem pour faire monter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} jusqu’à l’endroit qu’il avait préparé pour elle.

sw.L: Daudi akawakusanya Israeli wote huko Yerusalemu ili kulipandisha sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mahali pake, alipokuwa amepaandaa kwa ajili yake.
sw.B: Daudi aliwakusanya Israeli wote huko Yerusalemu ili kulipandisha sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mahali alipokuwa amepaandaa kwa ajili yake.
sw.R: Daudi aliwaita Israeli wote pamoja huko Yerusalemu ili kulipandisha sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mpaka mahali alipokuwa amepatayarisha kwa ajili yake.

vi.L: Đa-vít tập họp cả Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Giê-ru-sa-lem để đem hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lên chỗ của hòm, là chỗ ông đã chuẩn bị cho hòm.
vi.B: Đa-vít tập họp cả Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Giê-ru-sa-lem để rước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lên chỗ ông đã chuẩn bị cho hòm.
vi.R: Đa-vít triệu tập cả Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Giê-ru-sa-lem để rước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lên chỗ ông đã sửa soạn cho hòm.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 온 이스라엘을 예루살렘으로 모아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 그가 그것을 위하여 마련한 그 장소로 메어 올리려고 했다.
ko.B: 다윗은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 자기가 마련해 둔 곳으로 메어 올리려고 온 이스라엘을 예루살렘에 모았다.
ko.R: 다윗은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 자기가 준비해 둔 곳으로 메어 올리려고 온 이스라엘을 예루살렘으로 불러 모았다.

decisions.choice: all Israel: the people gathered from the whole nation
decisions.reason: As in 13:5, "all Israel" means the nation represented by its people and leaders (verse 25), not every single person. Chronicles often stresses that the whole people took part.

decisions.choice: bring up: carry up to the higher city
decisions.reason: Jerusalem stood high in the hill country, so going there is "going up". The ark had been left at the house of Obed-Edom (13:13-14), and is now to be brought up to the place of verse 1.

decisions.choice: made ready
decisions.reason: Readable says "made ready" for "prepared", as in verse 1.

source.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י אַֽהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶת־הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And gathered David [the] sons of Aaron and the Levites.

en.L: And David gathered the sons of Aaron and the Levites.
en.B: David gathered the sons of Aaron and the Levites.
en.R: David brought together the priests, who were Aaron's descendants, and the Levites.

es.L: Y reunió David a los hijos de Aarón y a los levitas.
es.B: David reunió a los hijos de Aarón y a los levitas.
es.R: David reunió a los sacerdotes, que eran descendientes de Aarón, y a los levitas.

fr.L: Et David réunit les fils d’Aaron et les Lévites.
fr.B: David réunit les fils d’Aaron et les Lévites.
fr.R: David a réuni les prêtres, qui étaient les descendants d’Aaron, et les Lévites.

sw.L: Daudi akawakusanya wana wa Haruni na Walawi.
sw.B: Daudi aliwakusanya wana wa Haruni na Walawi.
sw.R: Daudi aliwaleta pamoja makuhani, waliokuwa wazao wa Haruni, na Walawi.

vi.L: Đa-vít tập họp con cháu A-rôn và người Lê-vi.
vi.B: Đa-vít tập họp con cháu A-rôn và người Lê-vi.
vi.R: Đa-vít triệu tập các thầy tế lễ, là con cháu A-rôn, và người Lê-vi.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 아론의 자손과 레위인들을 모았다.
ko.B: 다윗은 아론의 자손과 레위인들을 모았다.
ko.R: 다윗은 아론의 자손인 제사장들과 레위인들을 불러 모았다.

decisions.choice: the sons of Aaron and the Levites: the priests and the rest of the tribe of Levi
decisions.reason: The priests were the descendants of Aaron. The other Levites assisted them and looked after the sanctuary and its holy things (Numbers 3:5-10). Both groups are called for the ark (verses 11 and 14).

decisions.choice: the priests, who were Aaron's descendants
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that the sons of Aaron were the priests.

source.text: לִבְנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת אוּרִיאֵ֣ל הַשָּׂ֔ר וְאֶחָ֖יו מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Of [the] sons of Kohath: Uriel the chief, and his brothers, 120.

en.L: Of the sons of Kohath: Uriel the chief, and his brothers, 120.
en.B: From the descendants of Kohath: Uriel the chief, and 120 of his relatives.
en.R: From the clan of Kohath came Uriel, their leader, and 120 of his relatives.

es.L: De los hijos de Coat: Uriel el jefe, y sus hermanos, 120.
es.B: De los descendientes de Coat: Uriel el jefe, y 120 de sus parientes.
es.R: Del clan de Coat vinieron Uriel, su jefe, y 120 de sus parientes.

fr.L: Des fils de Kehath : Ouriel le chef, et ses frères, 120.
fr.B: Des descendants de Kehath : Ouriel, le chef, et 120 de ses frères.
fr.R: Du clan de Kehath est venu Ouriel, leur chef, avec 120 hommes de sa famille.

sw.L: Wa wana wa Kohathi: Urieli mkuu, na ndugu zake, 120.
sw.B: Kutoka kwa wazao wa Kohathi: Urieli mkuu wao, na ndugu zake 120.
sw.R: Kutoka ukoo wa Kohathi alikuja Urieli, kiongozi wao, pamoja na ndugu zake 120.

vi.L: Từ con cháu Kê-hát: U-ri-ên người đứng đầu, và anh em ông, 120 [người].
vi.B: Từ con cháu Kê-hát: U-ri-ên người đứng đầu, cùng 120 người bà con của ông.
vi.R: Từ gia tộc Kê-hát có U-ri-ên, người lãnh đạo của họ, cùng 120 người bà con của ông.

ko.L: 그핫 자손 가운데서는 우두머리 우리엘과 그의 형제 120[명],
ko.B: 그핫 자손 가운데서는 우두머리 우리엘과 그의 친족 120명,
ko.R: 그핫 집안에서는 그들의 지도자 우리엘과 그의 친척 120명이 왔다.

decisions.choice: Kohath: one of the three sons of Levi
decisions.reason: Levi's sons were Gershom, Kohath and Merari (6:1; Exodus 6:16), and the Levites were organized by these clans. The Kohathites had the task of carrying the most holy things, the ark among them (Numbers 4:4-15). Verses 5-10 name six groups; four of them (Kohath, Elizaphan, Hebron and Uzziel) are Kohathite.

decisions.choice: the chief: the head of the clan
decisions.reason: The word is used for any leader or official. Here it is the head of a Levite clan, who leads his kinsmen (verse 12 calls them "heads of the fathers' houses").

decisions.choice: his brothers: his fellow clansmen
decisions.reason: "Brothers" means the men of his clan, his relatives, not only his brothers by birth.

decisions.choice: chief (Literal, Balanced); leader (Readable)
decisions.reason: For a head of a Levite clan, "chief" fits better than the "princes" or "officials" used for this word at court. Readable says "their leader". The same choice is made in verses 6-10, 16 and 22.

decisions.choice: his relatives
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "relatives" for "brothers" (m3), and put the number before them.

decisions.choice: el jefe; sus hermanos (L), sus parientes (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "brothers" for the men of the same clan; Balanced and Readable say "parientes", as the English says "relatives".

decisions.choice: "Kehath", "Merari", "Guershom"; "le chef" (L, B), "leur chef" (R)
decisions.reason: The sons of Levi keep the forms of the French Exodus and Numbers ("Kehath", "Merari"); Chronicles’ "Gershom" is written "Guershom" as the French Exodus writes Moses’ son. "Ses frères" keeps the Hebrew at Literal and Balanced, as the men of his clan; Readable says "sa famille".

decisions.choice: mkuu (L, B); kiongozi (R); ndugu zake

decisions.choice: "người đứng đầu" (L, B), "người lãnh đạo" (R); "anh em" (L), "bà con" (B, R)

decisions.choice: Amminadab: a Levite, not the Amminadab of Judah
decisions.reason: The same name belongs to a man of Judah, the father of Nahshon (2:10), and to a Kohathite in 6:7. This Amminadab is the head of Uzziel's descendants.

en.L: And he said to them, "You [are] the heads of the fathers' [houses] of the Levites. Consecrate yourselves, you and your brothers, and bring up the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel to [the place] I have prepared for it.

en.R: He told them, "You are the leaders of the Levite families. You and your relatives must make yourselves holy. Then bring the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, up to the place I have made ready for it.

es.L: Y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Ustedes [son]|Vosotros [sois]}} los jefes de las [casas] paternas de los levitas. {{plural_you:Santifíquense|Santificaos}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y sus hermanos, y {{plural_you:suban|subid}} el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} Dios de Israel al [lugar que] le he preparado.

fr.L: Et il leur dit : « Vous [êtes] les chefs des [maisons des] pères des Lévites. Sanctifiez-vous, vous et vos frères, et faites monter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, [au lieu] que j’ai préparé pour elle.
fr.B: Il leur dit : « Vous êtes les chefs des familles des Lévites. Sanctifiez-vous, vous et vos frères, et faites monter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, au lieu que j’ai préparé pour elle.
fr.R: Il leur a dit : « Vous êtes les chefs des familles des Lévites. Vous et les hommes de votre famille, vous devez vous purifier pour être prêts à servir Dieu. Ensuite, faites monter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, jusqu’à l’endroit que j’ai préparé pour elle.

sw.L: Akawaambia, "Ninyi [ni] wakuu wa [nyumba za] baba za Walawi. Jitakaseni, ninyi na ndugu zenu, mlipandishe sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa Israeli [mpaka mahali] nilipoliandalia.
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Ninyi ndio wakuu wa jamaa za Walawi. Jitakaseni, ninyi na ndugu zenu, mlipandishe sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, mpaka mahali nilipoliandalia.
sw.R: Akawaambia, "Ninyi ndio viongozi wa jamaa za Walawi. Ninyi na ndugu zenu lazima mjitakase, yaani mjiweke tayari kwa kazi takatifu. Kisha lipandisheni sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, mpaka mahali nilipolitayarishia.

vi.L: Ông nói với họ: "Các ông [là] những người đứng đầu các gia tộc của người Lê-vi. Hãy biệt mình ra thánh, các ông và anh em các ông, và đem hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên lên [nơi] ta đã chuẩn bị cho hòm.
vi.B: Ông nói với họ: "Các ông là những người đứng đầu các gia tộc Lê-vi. Các ông và bà con các ông hãy biệt mình ra thánh, rồi rước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, lên nơi ta đã chuẩn bị cho hòm.
vi.R: Ông bảo họ: "Các ông là những người lãnh đạo các gia tộc Lê-vi. Các ông và bà con các ông phải làm cho mình nên thánh. Rồi hãy rước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, lên nơi ta đã sửa soạn cho hòm.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그들에게 말했다. "너희는 레위인 조상들의 [집안의] 우두머리들이다. 너희와 너희 형제들은 자신을 거룩하게 하고, 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 내가 그것을 위하여 마련한 [곳으로] 메어 올려라.
ko.B: 그가 그들에게 말했다. "너희는 레위 가문의 우두머리들이다. 너희와 너희 친족들은 몸을 거룩하게 하고, 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 내가 마련한 곳으로 메어 올려라.
ko.R: 다윗이 그들에게 말했다. "너희는 레위 집안의 지도자들이다. 너희와 너희 친척들은 자신을 깨끗하고 거룩하게 해야 한다. 그런 다음에 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 내가 준비한 곳으로 메어 올려라.

decisions.choice: heads of the fathers: heads of the ancestral families
decisions.reason: A "house of the fathers" was an extended family within a clan. These men lead their families and speak for them.

decisions.choice: consecrate yourselves: make yourselves holy, ready to handle holy things
decisions.reason: To consecrate oneself was to prepare for coming near to what is holy, by washing, clean clothes and keeping away from what makes one unclean (Exodus 19:10-15, 22; Joshua 3:5).

decisions.choice: and bring up: a command
decisions.reason: The verb form continues the command "consecrate yourselves": first they are to make themselves holy, then they are to bring up the ark.

decisions.choice: fathers' [houses]; [the place]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the words the Hebrew leaves to be understood.

decisions.choice: make yourselves holy
decisions.reason: Readable says what "consecrate" means.

decisions.choice: plural_you on "ustedes / vosotros" and every verb addressed to the Levites
decisions.reason: David addresses the Levite chiefs together, so the pronouns, possessives and commands take the plural_you setting.

decisions.choice: "vous purifier pour être prêts à servir Dieu"
decisions.reason: Readable explains consecration, the preparation for coming near holy things, with common words; Literal and Balanced keep "se sanctifier".

decisions.choice: mjitakase, yaani mjiweke tayari kwa kazi takatifu
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the usual verb "kujitakasa" and explains it, since the English "make yourselves holy" would be awkward as "mjifanye watakatifu".

decisions.choice: The king says "ta" and "các ông" to the heads of the Levites
decisions.reason: As the Vietnamese 2 Samuel, the king says "ông" to the priests; the Levite heads are given the same respect.

decisions.choice: "biệt mình ra thánh" (L, B); "làm cho mình nên thánh" (R)
decisions.reason: Consecrating oneself is setting oneself apart for holy work; Readable uses the plainer "làm cho mình nên thánh".

decisions.choice: David speaks to the priests and Levite leaders in 해라체 with "너희"
decisions.reason: The king gives orders to his officials, as the Samuel note sets for the king and his subjects; in 13:2 he spoke in 합쇼체 because he was asking the whole assembly's consent.

source.text: כִּ֛י לְמַ בָּרִ֥אשׁוֹנָ֖הלֹ֣א אַתֶּ֑ם פָּרַ֨ץ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨ינוּ֙ בָּ֔נוּ כִּי־לֹ֥א דְרַשְׁנֻ֖הוּ כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: For because at the first [time] not you, broke out Yahweh our God against us, for not we sought him according to the rule.

en.L: For because at the first [time] you [did] not [carry it], {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God broke out against us, because we did not seek {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} according to the rule."
en.B: It was because you did not carry it the first time that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God burst out against us, since we did not seek {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as the rule required."
en.R: The first time, you did not carry it, and so {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God burst out against us. We did not seek {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had commanded."

es.L: Porque por no [haberla llevado] {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} la primera vez, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios irrumpió contra nosotros, porque no lo buscamos conforme a lo establecido».
es.B: Fue porque {{plural_you:ustedes no la llevaron|vosotros no la llevasteis}} la primera vez que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios irrumpió contra nosotros, pues no lo buscamos como lo establece la ley».
es.R: La primera vez {{plural_you:ustedes no la llevaron|vosotros no la llevasteis}}, y por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios nos castigó de golpe. No lo buscamos de la manera que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había mandado».

fr.L: Car parce que, la première [fois], vous [ne la portiez] pas, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu a fait une brèche parmi nous, parce que nous ne {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avons pas recherché selon la règle. »
fr.B: C’est parce que vous ne l’avez pas portée la première fois que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu a éclaté contre nous, car nous ne {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avons pas recherché comme la règle le demandait. »
fr.R: La première fois, ce n’est pas vous qui l’avez portée, et c’est pour cela que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu a éclaté contre nous. Nous ne {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avons pas recherché de la manière qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait ordonnée. »

sw.L: Kwa maana kwa sababu mara ya kwanza ninyi [hamkulibeba], {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu alifurika juu yetu, kwa sababu hatukumtafuta {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} sawasawa na agizo."
sw.B: Ni kwa sababu ninyi hamkulibeba mara ya kwanza ndipo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu alipotushukia ghafula, kwa kuwa hatukumtafuta {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kama agizo lilivyotaka."
sw.R: Mara ya kwanza ninyi hamkulibeba, na kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu alitushukia ghafula. Hatukumtafuta {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kwa njia aliyoiamuru."

vi.L: Vì lần đầu các ông [đã] không [khiêng hòm], nên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta đã bùng nổ cơn giận trên chúng ta, vì chúng ta đã không tìm cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} theo luật lệ."
vi.B: Chính vì lần đầu các ông đã không khiêng hòm, nên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta đã bùng nổ cơn giận trên chúng ta, bởi chúng ta đã không tìm cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đúng theo luật lệ."
vi.R: Lần đầu các ông đã không khiêng hòm, nên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta đã bùng nổ cơn giận trên chúng ta. Chúng ta đã không tìm cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} theo cách {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã truyền dạy."

ko.L: 처음에는 너희가 [메지] 않았기 때문에, 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리를 치셨다. 우리가 규례대로 그분을 찾지 않았기 때문이다."
ko.B: 처음에 너희가 궤를 메지 않았기 때문에 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리를 갑자기 치셨다. 우리가 규례대로 그분을 찾지 않았기 때문이다."
ko.R: 처음에는 너희가 궤를 메지 않았다. 그래서 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리를 갑자기 치셨다. 우리는 그분께서 명령하신 방법대로 그분을 찾지 않았다."

decisions.choice: because the first time you did not: you Levites did not carry the ark
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is very short: "because at the first, not you". From verses 2 and 12 the sense is that the Levites were not the ones who carried the ark on the first attempt, when it was set on a cart (13:7).

decisions.choice: the LORD broke out against us: the death of Uzzah
decisions.reason: David looks back to 13:9-11 (2 Samuel 6:6-8), when the LORD broke out against Uzzah and the place was named Perez-uzza, "breaking out against Uzza". The same verb is used here, and David now says "against us": the fault was the whole people's.

decisions.choice: we did not seek him: we did not turn to the LORD in the way he required
alternatives: we did not seek it (the ark) according to the rule
decisions.reason: To "seek" the LORD is to turn to him, ask his will and worship him. "Him" is most naturally the LORD just named. The same suffix could mean "it", the ark, as in 13:3, where David says they had not sought the ark in the days of Saul.

decisions.choice: according to the rule: as the law laid down
decisions.reason: The word means a ruling or ordinance, the right way something is to be done. The law said that the Kohathite Levites were to carry the holy things on their shoulders and must not touch them (Numbers 4:15; 7:9).

decisions.choice: did not carry it
decisions.reason: Every level supplies "carry it" (in brackets at Literal), the action the short Hebrew leaves to be understood (m1).

decisions.choice: in the way he had commanded
decisions.reason: Readable says "in the way he had commanded" for "according to the rule", since the rule is the one the LORD gave through Moses (verse 15).

decisions.choice: "nous ne l’avons pas recherché" (the LORD, masculine)
decisions.reason: The masculine past participle shows that "him" is the LORD, as the meaning decision reads it.

decisions.choice: "치셨다" (L), "갑자기 치셨다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the "breaking out" of 13:11 (Perez-uzzah); Korean "터뜨리다" needs an object such as Uzzah there, so with "us" it says "치셨다", and Balanced and Readable add "갑자기" as at 13:11.
