records.literal_gloss: And consecrated themselves the priests and the Levites to bring up [the] ark of Yahweh [the] God of Israel.

en.L: And the priests and the Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel.
en.B: So the priests and the Levites consecrated themselves in order to bring up the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.R: So the priests and the Levites made themselves holy, so that they could bring up the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.

es.L: Y se santificaron los sacerdotes y los levitas para subir el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} Dios de Israel.
es.B: Así que los sacerdotes y los levitas se santificaron para subir el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.
es.R: Así que los sacerdotes y los levitas se santificaron para poder subir el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.

fr.L: Et les prêtres et les Lévites se sanctifièrent pour faire monter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.B: Les prêtres et les Lévites se sanctifièrent donc pour faire monter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.R: Alors les prêtres et les Lévites se sont purifiés pour pouvoir faire monter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.

sw.L: Makuhani na Walawi wakajitakasa ili kulipandisha sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Basi makuhani na Walawi walijitakasa ili kulipandisha sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Basi makuhani na Walawi walijitakasa, ili waweze kulipandisha sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.

vi.L: Các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi biệt mình ra thánh để đem hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên lên.
vi.B: Vậy các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi biệt mình ra thánh để rước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, lên.
vi.R: Vậy các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi làm cho mình nên thánh để có thể rước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, lên.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들과 레위인들이 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 메어 올리려고 자신을 거룩하게 했다.
ko.B: 그래서 제사장들과 레위인들은 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 메어 올리려고 몸을 거룩하게 했다.
ko.R: 그래서 제사장들과 레위인들은 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 메어 올릴 수 있도록 자신을 깨끗하고 거룩하게 했다.

decisions.choice: consecrated themselves: they did what David told them
decisions.reason: The verse uses the same verb as David's command in verse 12; the priests and Levites obey.

decisions.choice: made themselves holy
decisions.reason: As in verse 12.

source.text: וַיִּשְׂא֣וּ בְנֵֽי־הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲר֣וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה בִּכְתֵפָ֥ם בַּמֹּט֖וֹת עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And carried [the] sons of the Levites the ark of the God as commanded Moses according to [the] word of Yahweh, on their shoulder, with the poles on them.

en.L: And the sons of the Levites carried the ark of God, as Moses had commanded according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, on their shoulders, with the poles on them.
en.B: The Levites carried the ark of God with the poles on their shoulders, as Moses had commanded by the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders, using the poles, just as Moses had commanded. This was what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said.

es.L: Y los hijos de los levitas llevaron el arca de Dios, como lo había mandado Moisés conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, sobre sus hombros, con las varas sobre ellos.
es.B: Los levitas llevaron el arca de Dios con las varas sobre los hombros, como Moisés lo había mandado por la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Entonces los levitas llevaron el arca de Dios sobre los hombros, usando las varas, tal como Moisés lo había mandado. Esto era lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho.

fr.L: Et les fils des Lévites portèrent l’arche de Dieu, comme Moïse l’avait ordonné selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, sur leur épaule, avec les barres sur eux.
fr.B: Les Lévites portèrent l’arche de Dieu sur leurs épaules avec les barres, comme Moïse l’avait ordonné d’après la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors les Lévites ont porté l’arche de Dieu sur leurs épaules, avec les barres, comme Moïse l’avait ordonné. C’était ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit.

sw.L: Wana wa Walawi wakalibeba sanduku la Mungu, kama Musa alivyoamuru sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mabegani mwao, na mipiko juu yao.
sw.B: Walawi walilibeba sanduku la Mungu kwa mipiko mabegani mwao, kama Musa alivyoamuru kwa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kisha Walawi walilibeba sanduku la Mungu mabegani mwao, wakitumia mipiko, kama vile Musa alivyoamuru. Ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa amesema.

vi.L: Con cháu Lê-vi khiêng hòm của Đức Chúa Trời, như Môi-se đã truyền theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trên vai họ, với các đòn khiêng trên mình họ.
vi.B: Người Lê-vi khiêng hòm của Đức Chúa Trời bằng đòn khiêng đặt trên vai, như Môi-se đã truyền theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Rồi người Lê-vi khiêng hòm của Đức Chúa Trời trên vai, dùng các đòn khiêng, đúng như Môi-se đã truyền. Đó là điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.

ko.L: 그리고 레위 자손이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀에 따라 모세가 명령한 대로, 하나님의 궤를 채에 꿰어 자기들의 어깨에 메었다.
ko.B: 레위인들은 모세가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀대로 명령한 그대로, 하나님의 궤를 채에 꿰어 어깨에 메었다.
ko.R: 그리고 레위인들은 하나님의 궤를 채에 꿰어 어깨에 메고 갔다. 모세가 명령한 그대로였다. 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 것이었다.

decisions.choice: as Moses had commanded according to the word of the LORD: the law for carrying the ark
decisions.reason: The ark had rings and poles so that it could be carried (Exodus 25:13-15), and the Kohathites were to carry the holy things on their shoulders (Numbers 4:15; 7:9). Moses gave the command, but it was the LORD's word.

decisions.choice: the sons of the Levites: the Levites themselves
decisions.reason: "Sons of" here marks members of the group, as in "sons of Israel". The Levites are meant, not their children.

decisions.choice: the poles: carrying poles
decisions.reason: The word means a bar or pole for carrying a load on the shoulders. Exodus uses a different word for the ark's poles, but the same objects are meant.

decisions.choice: the Levites carried the ark: told ahead of the procession itself
decisions.reason: The verse sums up what happened before verses 16-24 list the musicians and gatekeepers; the procession itself is told in verses 25-29.

decisions.choice: on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the description of how they carried the ark together and put Moses' command at the end. Readable makes the LORD's word a sentence of its own.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִיד֮ לְשָׂרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּם֒ לְהַֽעֲמִ֗יד אֶת־אֲחֵיהֶם֙ הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים בִּכְלֵי־שִׁ֛יר נְבָלִ֥ים וְכִנֹּר֖וֹת וּמְצִלְתָּ֑יִם מַשְׁמִיעִ֥ים לְהָרִֽים־בְּק֖וֹל לְשִׂמְחָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And said David to [the] chiefs of the Levites to appoint their brothers the singers with instruments of song, harps and lyres and cymbals, sounding aloud, to raise with [a] sound for joy.

en.L: And David told the chiefs of the Levites to appoint their brothers [as] the singers, with instruments of song, harps and lyres and cymbals, sounding aloud, to raise [the] sound for joy.
en.B: David also told the chiefs of the Levites to appoint some of their relatives as singers, with musical instruments, harps, lyres and cymbals, to play loudly and raise sounds of joy.
en.R: David also told the leaders of the Levites to choose some of their relatives to be singers. They were to play harps, lyres and cymbals loudly and make joyful music.

es.L: Y dijo David a los jefes de los levitas que designaran a sus hermanos los cantores, con instrumentos de música, arpas y liras y címbalos, que hicieran oír [su sonido], para alzar la voz con alegría.
es.B: David también dijo a los jefes de los levitas que designaran a algunos de sus parientes como cantores, con instrumentos de música, arpas, liras y címbalos, para tocar con fuerza y alzar sonidos de alegría.
es.R: David también les dijo a los jefes de los levitas que escogieran a algunos de sus parientes para que fueran cantores. Debían tocar con fuerza arpas, liras y címbalos, y hacer música alegre.

fr.L: Et David dit aux chefs des Lévites d’établir leurs frères, les chantres, avec des instruments de chant, harpes et lyres et cymbales, faisant entendre [à haute voix], pour élever [le] son avec joie.
fr.B: David dit aussi aux chefs des Lévites d’établir certains de leurs frères comme chanteurs, avec des instruments de musique, harpes, lyres et cymbales, pour jouer fort et faire éclater des sons de joie.
fr.R: David a aussi dit aux chefs des Lévites de choisir certains hommes de leur famille comme chanteurs. Ils devaient jouer très fort de la harpe, de la lyre et des cymbales, et faire de la musique joyeuse.

sw.L: Daudi akawaambia wakuu wa Walawi wawaweke ndugu zao [kuwa] waimbaji, pamoja na vyombo vya nyimbo, zeze na vinubi na matoazi, wakipiga kwa sauti kuu, kupaza sauti kwa furaha.
sw.B: Daudi aliwaambia pia wakuu wa Walawi wawaweke baadhi ya ndugu zao kuwa waimbaji, wenye vyombo vya muziki, zeze, vinubi na matoazi, wapige kwa sauti kuu na kupaza sauti za furaha.
sw.R: Daudi aliwaambia pia viongozi wa Walawi wawachague baadhi ya ndugu zao wawe waimbaji. Walipaswa kupiga zeze, vinubi na matoazi kwa sauti kuu na kufanya muziki wa furaha.

vi.L: Đa-vít bảo những người đứng đầu người Lê-vi lập anh em họ [làm] người ca hát, với các nhạc khí ca hát, đàn hạc, đàn lia và chập chõa, để tấu vang, cất tiếng vui mừng.
vi.B: Đa-vít cũng bảo các người đứng đầu người Lê-vi lập một số bà con của họ làm người ca hát, với các nhạc cụ, đàn hạc, đàn lia và chập chõa, để tấu vang và cất lên những âm thanh vui mừng.
vi.R: Đa-vít cũng bảo các nhà lãnh đạo người Lê-vi chọn một số bà con của họ làm người ca hát. Họ phải chơi đàn hạc, đàn lia và chập chõa thật lớn, tấu lên những bản nhạc vui mừng.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 레위인의 우두머리들에게 말하여, 그들의 형제들을 노래하는 사람으로 세워 비파와 수금과 심벌즈 같은 악기로 크게 울려 기쁨의 소리를 높이게 했다.
ko.B: 다윗은 또 레위인의 우두머리들에게 말하여, 그들의 친족 가운데서 노래하는 사람들을 세우게 했다. 그들은 비파와 수금과 심벌즈를 크게 연주하며 기쁨의 소리를 높여야 했다.
ko.R: 다윗은 또 레위인의 지도자들에게 그들의 친척 가운데서 노래하는 사람들을 뽑으라고 했다. 그들은 비파와 수금과 심벌즈를 크게 연주하며 즐거운 음악을 울려야 했다.

decisions.choice: harps: a larger stringed instrument
decisions.reason: The word names a stringed instrument larger than the lyre, probably a harp or a kind of large lyre. Its exact shape is not known.

decisions.choice: lyres: the smaller stringed instrument David played
decisions.reason: This is the instrument David played for Saul (1 Samuel 16:23), a lyre with a wooden frame. The two stringed instruments are named together, as in 2 Samuel 6:5.

decisions.choice: cymbals: a pair of metal plates struck together
decisions.reason: The word has the form used for pairs of things. Verse 19 says they were of bronze.

decisions.choice: David appoints the singers: the start of the Levite music for worship
decisions.reason: Chronicles tells that David set Levites over the music of the LORD's house (6:16-17), and later kings followed his order (2 Chronicles 29:25). The Levites who had carried the tabernacle now have a new work of praise.

decisions.choice: sounding aloud, to raise a sound for joy: playing loudly in celebration
decisions.reason: The first verb means to make heard; the second means to lift up. Together they describe loud music and singing for joy.

decisions.choice: some of their relatives
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "some of", since verses 17-24 show that only some of the Levites were made singers. "Relatives" is "brothers" as in verse 5.

decisions.choice: arpas, liras, címbalos
decisions.reason: The same three instruments as in the Spanish of 2 Samuel 6 and the Psalms: "arpa" for the larger stringed instrument, "lira" for the smaller one David played.

decisions.choice: "chantres" (L); "chanteurs" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Kings terms note sets "les chanteurs"; Literal keeps the older "chantres", the word for those who sing in worship, as the Hebrew names a temple office.

decisions.choice: "người ca hát"; "đàn hạc", "đàn lia", "chập chõa"
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the singers, and the instrument names of the Vietnamese 2 Samuel 6 and Psalms, kept for the Levite musicians through the block.

decisions.choice: "노래하는 사람"; "비파, 수금, 심벌즈"
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the singers, and the instrument names of 2 Samuel 6:5 in Korean (harp "비파", lyre "수금").

source.text: וַיַּעֲמִ֣ידוּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֵ֚ת הֵימָ֣ן בֶּן־יוֹאֵ֔ל וּמִ֨ן־אֶחָ֔יו אָסָ֖ף בֶּן־בֶּֽרֶכְיָ֑הוּסוּמִן־בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ אֲחֵיהֶ֔ם אֵיתָ֖ן בֶּן־קֽוּשָׁיָֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And appointed the Levites Heman son of Joel, and of his brothers Asaph son of Berechiah, and of [the] sons of Merari their brothers Ethan son of Kushaiah.

en.L: And the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel, and from his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah, and from the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah.
en.B: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his relatives, Asaph son of Berechiah; and from their relatives the descendants of Merari, Ethan son of Kushaiah.
en.R: So the Levites chose Heman son of Joel. From his relatives they chose Asaph son of Berechiah. And from the clan of Merari, who were also their relatives, they chose Ethan son of Kushaiah.

es.L: Y los levitas designaron a Hemán hijo de Joel, y de sus hermanos, a Asaf hijo de Berequías; y de los hijos de Merari, sus hermanos, a Etán hijo de Cusaías.
es.B: Así que los levitas designaron a Hemán hijo de Joel; de sus parientes, a Asaf hijo de Berequías; y de sus parientes los descendientes de Merari, a Etán hijo de Cusaías.
es.R: Así que los levitas escogieron a Hemán hijo de Joel. De sus parientes escogieron a Asaf hijo de Berequías. Y del clan de Merari, que también eran sus parientes, escogieron a Etán hijo de Cusaías.

fr.L: Et les Lévites établirent Hémân, fils de Joël, et, parmi ses frères, Asaph, fils de Bérékia, et, parmi les fils de Merari, leurs frères, Éthân, fils de Koushaya.
fr.B: Les Lévites établirent donc Hémân, fils de Joël ; parmi ses frères, Asaph, fils de Bérékia ; et parmi leurs frères, les descendants de Merari, Éthân, fils de Koushaya.
fr.R: Les Lévites ont donc choisi Hémân, fils de Joël. Parmi les hommes de sa famille, ils ont choisi Asaph, fils de Bérékia. Et dans le clan de Merari, qui faisait aussi partie de leur famille, ils ont choisi Éthân, fils de Koushaya.

sw.L: Walawi wakamweka Hemani mwana wa Yoeli, na katika ndugu zake, Asafu mwana wa Berekia; na katika wana wa Merari ndugu zao, Ethani mwana wa Kushaya.
sw.B: Basi Walawi wakamweka Hemani mwana wa Yoeli; katika ndugu zake, Asafu mwana wa Berekia; na katika ndugu zao wazao wa Merari, Ethani mwana wa Kushaya.
sw.R: Basi Walawi walimchagua Hemani mwana wa Yoeli. Katika ndugu zake wakamchagua Asafu mwana wa Berekia. Na katika ukoo wa Merari, ambao pia walikuwa ndugu zao, wakamchagua Ethani mwana wa Kushaya.

vi.L: Người Lê-vi lập Hê-man con trai Giô-ên, và trong anh em ông, A-sáp con trai Bê-rê-kia, và trong con cháu Mê-ra-ri, anh em họ, Ê-than con trai Cu-sai-gia.
vi.B: Vậy người Lê-vi lập Hê-man con trai Giô-ên; trong bà con ông thì lập A-sáp con trai Bê-rê-kia; và trong bà con họ là con cháu Mê-ra-ri thì lập Ê-than con trai Cu-sai-gia.
vi.R: Vậy người Lê-vi chọn Hê-man con trai Giô-ên. Trong bà con của ông, họ chọn A-sáp con trai Bê-rê-kia. Và trong gia tộc Mê-ra-ri, cũng là bà con của họ, họ chọn Ê-than con trai Cu-sai-gia.

ko.L: 그리고 레위인들이 요엘의 아들 헤만을, 그리고 그의 형제들 가운데서 베레갸의 아들 아삽을, 그리고 그들의 형제 므라리 자손 가운데서 구사야의 아들 에단을 세웠다.
ko.B: 그래서 레위인들은 요엘의 아들 헤만을 세우고, 그의 친족 가운데서 베레갸의 아들 아삽을, 그들의 친족인 므라리 자손 가운데서 구사야의 아들 에단을 세웠다.
ko.R: 그래서 레위인들은 요엘의 아들 헤만을 뽑았다. 또 그의 친척 가운데서 베레갸의 아들 아삽을 뽑았다. 그리고 그들의 친척인 므라리 집안에서 구사야의 아들 에단을 뽑았다.

decisions.choice: Heman, Asaph and Ethan: the three heads of the singers
decisions.reason: The family lists in 6:18-32 trace Heman to Kohath (6:18-23), Asaph to Gershom (6:24-28) and Ethan to Merari (6:29-32), so each of Levi's three clans has a leader of song. Psalms carry the names of Asaph (Psalms 50; 73-83), Heman (Psalm 88) and Ethan (Psalm 89).

decisions.choice: Kushaiah: called Kishi in 6:29
decisions.reason: Ethan's father is Kishi in 6:29 and Kushaiah here; they are two forms of one name. Later lists name Jeduthun beside Heman and Asaph (16:41-42; 25:1), and he may be the same man as Ethan.

decisions.choice: chose
decisions.reason: Readable says "chose" for "appointed", as in verse 16.

decisions.choice: "Hémân", "Asaph", "Éthân"
decisions.reason: The three heads of the singers keep the forms of the French Psalm titles (Psalms 50, 88, 89).

source.text: וְעִמָּהֶ֖ם אֲחֵיהֶ֣ם הַמִּשְׁנִ֑ים זְכַרְיָ֡הוּ בֵּ֡ן וְיַֽעֲזִיאֵ֡ל וּשְׁמִֽירָמ֡וֹת וִיחִיאֵ֣ל׀וְעֻנִּ֡י אֱלִיאָ֡ב וּבְנָיָ֡הוּ וּמַֽעֲשֵׂיָ֡הוּ וּמַתִּתְיָהוּ֩ וֶאֱלִ֨יפְלֵ֜הוּ וּמִקְנֵיָ֨הוּ וְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם וִֽיעִיאֵ֖ל הַשֹּׁעֲרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And with them their brothers the second [rank]: Zechariah, Ben and Jaaziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Unni, Eliab and Benaiah and Maaseiah and Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah and Obed-Edom and Jeiel the gatekeepers.

en.L: And with them [were] their brothers of the second [rank]: Zechariah, Ben and Jaaziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Unni, Eliab and Benaiah and Maaseiah and Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.
en.B: With them were their relatives of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu and Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers Obed-Edom and Jeiel.
en.R: Working with them were relatives who were next in rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu and Mikneiah. Obed-Edom and Jeiel, who were gatekeepers, were also with them.

es.L: Y con ellos [estaban] sus hermanos del segundo [rango]: Zacarías, Ben y Jaaziel y Semiramot y Jehiel y Uni, Eliab y Benaía y Maasías y Matatías y Elifelehu y Micnías, y Obed-edom y Jeiel, los porteros.
es.B: Con ellos estaban sus parientes de segundo rango: Zacarías, Ben, Jaaziel, Semiramot, Jehiel, Uni, Eliab, Benaía, Maasías, Matatías, Elifelehu y Micnías, y los porteros Obed-edom y Jeiel.
es.R: Con ellos trabajaban parientes de un rango menor: Zacarías, Ben, Jaaziel, Semiramot, Jehiel, Uni, Eliab, Benaía, Maasías, Matatías, Elifelehu y Micnías. Obed-edom y Jeiel, que eran porteros, también estaban con ellos.

fr.L: Et avec eux, leurs frères du second [rang] : Zacharie, Ben et Yaaziel et Shemiramoth et Yehiel et Ounni, Éliab et Benaya et Maaséya et Mattitya et Éliphelehou et Miqnéya, et Obed-Édom et Yeïel, les portiers.
fr.B: Avec eux, il y avait leurs frères du second rang : Zacharie, Ben, Yaaziel, Shemiramoth, Yehiel, Ounni, Éliab, Benaya, Maaséya, Mattitya, Éliphelehou et Miqnéya, ainsi que les portiers Obed-Édom et Yeïel.
fr.R: Avec eux travaillaient des hommes de leur famille qui venaient au second rang : Zacharie, Ben, Yaaziel, Shemiramoth, Yehiel, Ounni, Éliab, Benaya, Maaséya, Mattitya, Éliphelehou et Miqnéya. Obed-Édom et Yeïel, qui étaient portiers, étaient aussi avec eux.

sw.L: Na pamoja nao [walikuwa] ndugu zao wa [daraja la] pili: Zekaria, Beni na Yaazieli na Shemiramothi na Yehieli na Uni, Eliabu na Benaya na Maaseya na Matithia na Elifelehu na Mikneya, na Obed-edomu na Yeieli, mabawabu.
sw.B: Pamoja nao walikuwa ndugu zao wa daraja la pili: Zekaria, Beni, Yaazieli, Shemiramothi, Yehieli, Uni, Eliabu, Benaya, Maaseya, Matithia, Elifelehu na Mikneya, na mabawabu Obed-edomu na Yeieli.
sw.R: Waliofanya kazi pamoja nao walikuwa ndugu zao waliofuata kwa cheo: Zekaria, Beni, Yaazieli, Shemiramothi, Yehieli, Uni, Eliabu, Benaya, Maaseya, Matithia, Elifelehu na Mikneya. Obed-edomu na Yeieli, waliokuwa walinzi wa malango, walikuwa pamoja nao pia.

vi.L: Cùng với họ [có] anh em họ thuộc hàng thứ hai: Xa-cha-ri, Bên, Gia-a-xi-ên, Sê-mi-ra-mốt, Giê-hi-ên, U-ni, Ê-li-áp, Bê-na-gia, Ma-a-sê-gia, Ma-ti-thia, Ê-li-phê-lê-hu và Mích-nê-gia, và Ô-bết Ê-đôm và Giê-i-ên, những người giữ cổng.
vi.B: Cùng với họ có những người bà con thuộc hàng thứ hai: Xa-cha-ri, Bên, Gia-a-xi-ên, Sê-mi-ra-mốt, Giê-hi-ên, U-ni, Ê-li-áp, Bê-na-gia, Ma-a-sê-gia, Ma-ti-thia, Ê-li-phê-lê-hu và Mích-nê-gia, cùng những người giữ cổng là Ô-bết Ê-đôm và Giê-i-ên.
vi.R: Làm việc với họ có những người bà con ở hàng kế tiếp: Xa-cha-ri, Bên, Gia-a-xi-ên, Sê-mi-ra-mốt, Giê-hi-ên, U-ni, Ê-li-áp, Bê-na-gia, Ma-a-sê-gia, Ma-ti-thia, Ê-li-phê-lê-hu và Mích-nê-gia. Ô-bết Ê-đôm và Giê-i-ên, là những người giữ cổng, cũng ở với họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들과 함께 둘째 [서열의] 그들의 형제들, 곧 스가랴, 벤과 야아시엘과 스미라못과 여히엘과 운니, 엘리압과 브나야와 마아세야와 맛디디야와 엘리블레후와 믹네야와 문지기 오벳에돔과 여이엘이 [있었다].
ko.B: 그들과 함께 둘째 서열의 친족들이 있었는데, 스가랴, 벤, 야아시엘, 스미라못, 여히엘, 운니, 엘리압, 브나야, 마아세야, 맛디디야, 엘리블레후, 믹네야, 그리고 문지기인 오벳에돔과 여이엘이었다.
ko.R: 그 다음 서열의 친척들도 그들과 함께 일했다. 그들은 스가랴, 벤, 야아시엘, 스미라못, 여히엘, 운니, 엘리압, 브나야, 마아세야, 맛디디야, 엘리블레후, 믹네야였다. 문지기인 오벳에돔과 여이엘도 그들과 함께 있었다.

decisions.choice: the second rank: assistants to the three leaders
decisions.reason: The word means "second" or "next in order". These men served under Heman, Asaph and Ethan, and verses 20-21 give their instruments.

decisions.choice: Ben: kept as a name, as the Hebrew text has it
alternatives: leave Ben out, as the Greek does
decisions.reason: "Ben" is the word for "son", and a man called simply Ben is found nowhere else. He is missing from the same list in verse 20, and the Greek translation does not have him. The word may be left over from a phrase such as "Zechariah son of ..." in copying. The Hebrew text is kept here.

decisions.choice: the gatekeepers: Obed-Edom and Jeiel
decisions.reason: The title belongs to the last two names. Obed-Edom is a gatekeeper again in verse 24 and 16:38, and in verse 21 he also plays the lyre. Whether he is the Obed-Edom at whose house the ark stayed (13:13-14) is not said; 26:4-8 lists the gatekeeper's large family as a sign of God's blessing.

decisions.choice: the gatekeepers Obed-Edom and Jeiel
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the title before the two names so that it is not read as applying to the whole list; Readable makes them a sentence of their own.

decisions.choice: mabawabu (L, B); walinzi wa malango (R)
decisions.reason: The gatekeepers are "mabawabu", as the terms note sets for these books; Readable says "walinzi wa malango" (guards of the gates).

source.text: וְהַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים הֵימָ֥ן אָסָ֖ף וְאֵיתָ֑ן בִּמְצִלְתַּ֥יִם נְחֹ֖שֶׁת לְהַשְׁמִֽיעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the singers, Heman, Asaph and Ethan, with cymbals of bronze to sound aloud.

en.L: And the singers, Heman, Asaph and Ethan, [were] with bronze cymbals, to sound aloud.
en.B: The singers Heman, Asaph and Ethan were to play bronze cymbals loudly.
en.R: The singers Heman, Asaph and Ethan were to play loud bronze cymbals.

es.L: Y los cantores, Hemán, Asaf y Etán, [estaban] con címbalos de bronce, para hacerse oír.
es.B: Los cantores Hemán, Asaf y Etán debían tocar con fuerza címbalos de bronce.
es.R: Los cantores Hemán, Asaf y Etán debían tocar sonoros címbalos de bronce.

fr.L: Et les chantres, Hémân, Asaph et Éthân, [étaient] avec des cymbales de bronze pour faire entendre [la musique].
fr.B: Les chanteurs Hémân, Asaph et Éthân devaient jouer fort des cymbales de bronze.
fr.R: Les chanteurs Hémân, Asaph et Éthân devaient jouer des cymbales de bronze qui résonnaient fort.

sw.L: Na waimbaji, Hemani, Asafu na Ethani, [walikuwa] na matoazi ya shaba, kupiga kwa sauti kuu.
sw.B: Waimbaji Hemani, Asafu na Ethani walipaswa kupiga matoazi ya shaba kwa sauti kuu.
sw.R: Waimbaji Hemani, Asafu na Ethani walipaswa kupiga matoazi ya shaba yenye sauti kuu.

vi.L: Những người ca hát, Hê-man, A-sáp và Ê-than, [chơi] chập chõa bằng đồng, để tấu vang.
vi.B: Những người ca hát Hê-man, A-sáp và Ê-than chơi chập chõa bằng đồng thật vang.
vi.R: Những người ca hát Hê-man, A-sáp và Ê-than chơi chập chõa bằng đồng thật lớn.

ko.L: 그리고 노래하는 사람들 헤만, 아삽과 에단은 놋 심벌즈로 크게 울리게 [했다].
ko.B: 노래하는 사람들인 헤만과 아삽과 에단은 놋 심벌즈를 크게 울리게 되어 있었다.
ko.R: 노래하는 사람 헤만과 아삽과 에단은 놋 심벌즈를 크게 울려야 했다.

decisions.choice: the leaders with cymbals
decisions.reason: The three leaders play the cymbals, perhaps to set the beat or to mark the start and end of the songs. Asaph has the cymbals again in 16:5.

decisions.choice: to sound aloud: to make the music heard
decisions.reason: As in verse 16, the verb means "to make heard".

decisions.choice: were to play
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the verb the Hebrew leaves out.

source.text: וּזְכַרְיָ֨ה וַעֲזִיאֵ֜ל וּשְׁמִֽירָמ֤וֹת וִֽיחִיאֵל֙ וְעֻנִּ֣י וֶֽאֱלִיאָ֔ב וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֖הוּ וּבְנָיָ֑הוּ בִּנְבָלִ֖ים עַל־עֲלָמֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And Zechariah and Aziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Unni and Eliab and Maaseiah and Benaiah with harps on alamoth.

en.L: And Zechariah and Aziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Unni and Eliab and Maaseiah and Benaiah [were] with harps, on alamoth.
en.B: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah and Benaiah were to play harps, on alamoth.
en.R: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah and Benaiah were to play harps for high voices.

es.L: Y Zacarías y Aziel y Semiramot y Jehiel y Uni y Eliab y Maasías y Benaía [estaban] con arpas, sobre alamot.
es.B: Zacarías, Aziel, Semiramot, Jehiel, Uni, Eliab, Maasías y Benaía debían tocar arpas, sobre alamot.
es.R: Zacarías, Aziel, Semiramot, Jehiel, Uni, Eliab, Maasías y Benaía debían tocar arpas para voces agudas.

fr.L: Et Zacharie, et Aziel, et Shemiramoth, et Yehiel, et Ounni, et Éliab, et Maaséya, et Benaya [étaient] avec des harpes, sur alamoth.
fr.B: Zacharie, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Yehiel, Ounni, Éliab, Maaséya et Benaya devaient jouer de la harpe, sur alamoth.
fr.R: Zacharie, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Yehiel, Ounni, Éliab, Maaséya et Benaya devaient jouer de la harpe pour les voix aiguës.

sw.L: Na Zekaria na Azieli na Shemiramothi na Yehieli na Uni na Eliabu na Maaseya na Benaya [walikuwa] na zeze, kwa alamothi.
sw.B: Zekaria, Azieli, Shemiramothi, Yehieli, Uni, Eliabu, Maaseya na Benaya walipaswa kupiga zeze, kwa alamothi.
sw.R: Zekaria, Azieli, Shemiramothi, Yehieli, Uni, Eliabu, Maaseya na Benaya walipaswa kupiga zeze kwa ajili ya sauti za juu.

vi.L: Xa-cha-ri, A-xi-ên, Sê-mi-ra-mốt, Giê-hi-ên, U-ni, Ê-li-áp, Ma-a-sê-gia và Bê-na-gia [chơi] đàn hạc, theo [điệu] A-la-mốt.
vi.B: Xa-cha-ri, A-xi-ên, Sê-mi-ra-mốt, Giê-hi-ên, U-ni, Ê-li-áp, Ma-a-sê-gia và Bê-na-gia chơi đàn hạc theo điệu A-la-mốt.
vi.R: Xa-cha-ri, A-xi-ên, Sê-mi-ra-mốt, Giê-hi-ên, U-ni, Ê-li-áp, Ma-a-sê-gia và Bê-na-gia chơi đàn hạc cho giọng cao.

ko.L: 그리고 스가랴와 아시엘과 스미라못과 여히엘과 운니와 엘리압과 마아세야와 브나야는 비파로 알라못에 맞추어 [연주했다].
ko.B: 스가랴, 아시엘, 스미라못, 여히엘, 운니, 엘리압, 마아세야, 브나야는 알라못에 맞추어 비파를 연주하게 되어 있었다.
ko.R: 스가랴, 아시엘, 스미라못, 여히엘, 운니, 엘리압, 마아세야, 브나야는 높은 음역에 맞추어 비파를 연주해야 했다.

decisions.choice: on alamoth: a musical term, perhaps "for high voices"
alternatives: a tune or instrument whose name is lost
decisions.reason: The word is the plural of the word for a young woman, and it heads Psalm 46. It is a musical direction, perhaps for high voices or instruments set to a high pitch, but its exact sense is no longer known.

decisions.choice: Aziel: the Jaaziel of verse 18
decisions.reason: The list repeats the first eight names of verse 18, with Aziel for Jaaziel (two forms of one name), without Ben, and with Maaseiah before Benaiah.

decisions.choice: on alamoth (Literal, Balanced); for high voices (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 46:1, Literal and Balanced keep the term and Readable gives its likeliest sense (m1).

decisions.choice: sobre alamot (L, B); para voces agudas (R)
decisions.reason: As the Spanish title of Psalm 46.

decisions.choice: "theo [điệu] A-la-mốt" (L); "theo điệu A-la-mốt" (B); "cho giọng cao" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the published Vietnamese Psalm 46:1 for the same musical term.

decisions.choice: "알라못에 맞추어" (L, B); "높은 음역에 맞추어" (R)
decisions.reason: As the published Korean Psalm 46:1: Literal and Balanced keep the term, Readable gives its likeliest sense.

source.text: וּמַתִּתְיָ֣הוּ וֶאֱלִֽיפְלֵ֗הוּ וּמִקְנֵיָ֨הוּ֙ וְעֹבֵ֣ד אֱדֹ֔ם וִֽיעִיאֵ֖ל וַעֲזַזְיָ֑הוּ בְּכִנֹּר֥וֹת עַל־הַשְּׁמִינִ֖ית לְנַצֵּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah and Obed-Edom and Jeiel and Azaziah with lyres on the sheminith to lead.

en.L: And Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah and Obed-Edom and Jeiel and Azaziah [were] with lyres, on the sheminith, to lead.
en.B: Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel and Azaziah were to lead with lyres, on the sheminith.
en.R: Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel and Azaziah were to lead the music on lyres, set to "the eighth".

es.L: Y Matatías y Elifelehu y Micnías y Obed-edom y Jeiel y Azazías [estaban] con liras, sobre la seminit, para dirigir.
es.B: Matatías, Elifelehu, Micnías, Obed-edom, Jeiel y Azazías debían dirigir con liras, sobre la seminit.
es.R: Matatías, Elifelehu, Micnías, Obed-edom, Jeiel y Azazías debían dirigir la música con liras, en «la octava».

fr.L: Et Mattitya, et Éliphelehou, et Miqnéya, et Obed-Édom, et Yeïel, et Azazia [étaient] avec des lyres, sur la sheminith, pour diriger.
fr.B: Mattitya, Éliphelehou, Miqnéya, Obed-Édom, Yeïel et Azazia devaient diriger avec des lyres, sur la sheminith.
fr.R: Mattitya, Éliphelehou, Miqnéya, Obed-Édom, Yeïel et Azazia devaient diriger la musique en jouant de la lyre, sur « la huitième ».

sw.L: Na Matithia na Elifelehu na Mikneya na Obed-edomu na Yeieli na Azazia [walikuwa] na vinubi, kwa sheminithi, kuongoza.
sw.B: Matithia, Elifelehu, Mikneya, Obed-edomu, Yeieli na Azazia walipaswa kuongoza kwa vinubi, kwa sheminithi.
sw.R: Matithia, Elifelehu, Mikneya, Obed-edomu, Yeieli na Azazia walipaswa kuongoza muziki kwa vinubi, kwa mtindo uitwao "wa nane".

vi.L: Ma-ti-thia, Ê-li-phê-lê-hu, Mích-nê-gia, Ô-bết Ê-đôm, Giê-i-ên và A-xa-xia [chơi] đàn lia, theo [điệu] Sê-mi-nít, để điều khiển.
vi.B: Ma-ti-thia, Ê-li-phê-lê-hu, Mích-nê-gia, Ô-bết Ê-đôm, Giê-i-ên và A-xa-xia chơi đàn lia theo điệu Sê-mi-nít để điều khiển ban nhạc.
vi.R: Ma-ti-thia, Ê-li-phê-lê-hu, Mích-nê-gia, Ô-bết Ê-đôm, Giê-i-ên và A-xa-xia chơi đàn lia theo "cung thứ tám" để dẫn dắt ban nhạc.

ko.L: 그리고 맛디디야와 엘리블레후와 믹네야와 오벳에돔과 여이엘과 아사시야는 수금으로 스미닛에 맞추어 인도[했다].
ko.B: 맛디디야, 엘리블레후, 믹네야, 오벳에돔, 여이엘, 아사시야는 스미닛에 맞추어 수금을 연주하며 인도하게 되어 있었다.
ko.R: 맛디디야, 엘리블레후, 믹네야, 오벳에돔, 여이엘, 아사시야는 "여덟째"에 맞추어 수금을 연주하며 음악을 이끌어야 했다.

decisions.choice: the sheminith: "the eighth", a musical term
decisions.reason: The word means "the eighth" and heads Psalms 6 and 12. It may name a pitch, a tune or an instrument, perhaps a lower pitch set against the alamoth of verse 20; its sense is no longer known.

decisions.choice: to lead: to direct the music
decisions.reason: The verb means to oversee or lead. The same word stands in the heading "for the director" at the start of many psalms (Psalm 4:1).

decisions.choice: Azaziah: a name not in verse 18
decisions.reason: The six names repeat the last six of verse 18 and add Azaziah.

decisions.choice: on the sheminith (Literal, Balanced); set to "the eighth" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 6:1, Literal and Balanced keep the term and Readable translates the word.

decisions.choice: sobre la seminit (L, B); en «la octava» (R)
decisions.reason: As the Spanish title of Psalm 6.

decisions.choice: "sur la sheminith" (L, B); "sur « la huitième »" (R)
decisions.reason: The musical terms keep the wording of the French Psalm titles (Psalms 6 and 46: "sur alamoth", "pour voix aiguës", "sur la sheminith", "« la huitième »").

decisions.choice: "theo [điệu] Sê-mi-nít" (L); "theo điệu Sê-mi-nít" (B); "theo "cung thứ tám"" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the published Vietnamese Psalms 6:1 and 12:1 for the same term.

decisions.choice: "스미닛에 맞추어" (L, B); "\"여덟째\"에 맞추어" (R)
decisions.reason: As the published Korean Psalm 6:1.

source.text: וּכְנַנְיָ֥הוּ שַֽׂר־הַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּמַשָּׂ֑א יָסֹר֙ בַּמַּשָּׂ֔א כִּ֥י מֵבִ֖ין הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites in lifting up, instructing in the lifting up, for skilled [was] he.

en.L: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites in the lifting up [of song], instructed in the lifting up [of song], for he [was] skilled.
en.B: Chenaniah, the chief of the Levites in charge of the music, directed the music, because he was skilled at it.
en.R: Chenaniah, a leader of the Levites, was in charge of the music. He directed it because he was skilled at it.

es.L: Y Quenanías, jefe de los levitas en el canto, dirigía el canto, porque [era] entendido.
es.B: Quenanías, el jefe de los levitas encargado de la música, dirigía la música, porque era experto en ello.
es.R: Quenanías, uno de los jefes de los levitas, estaba a cargo de la música. Él la dirigía porque era experto en ello.

fr.L: Et Kenania, chef des Lévites pour le transport [du chant], dirigeait le transport [du chant], car il [était] habile.
fr.B: Kenania, le chef des Lévites chargé de la musique, dirigeait la musique, car il s’y connaissait.
fr.R: Kenania, un chef des Lévites, était responsable de la musique. Il la dirigeait parce qu’il était doué pour cela.

sw.L: Na Kenania, mkuu wa Walawi katika kupaza [nyimbo], alifundisha katika kupaza [nyimbo], kwa maana yeye [alikuwa] stadi.
sw.B: Kenania, mkuu wa Walawi aliyesimamia muziki, aliongoza muziki, kwa sababu alikuwa stadi katika kazi hiyo.
sw.R: Kenania, kiongozi mmoja wa Walawi, alisimamia muziki. Aliuongoza kwa sababu alikuwa stadi katika kazi hiyo.

vi.L: Kê-na-nia, người đứng đầu người Lê-vi về việc cất [tiếng hát], hướng dẫn việc cất [tiếng hát], vì ông thành thạo.
vi.B: Kê-na-nia, người đứng đầu người Lê-vi phụ trách âm nhạc, điều khiển phần âm nhạc, vì ông thông thạo việc ấy.
vi.R: Kê-na-nia, một nhà lãnh đạo người Lê-vi, phụ trách âm nhạc. Ông điều khiển ban nhạc vì ông giỏi việc ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 레위인의 우두머리 그나냐는 [노래를] 높이는 일에서 [노래를] 높이는 일을 가르쳤다. 그가 능숙했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 레위인의 우두머리로 음악을 맡은 그나냐는 음악을 지도했다. 그가 그 일에 능숙했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 레위인의 지도자 그나냐가 음악을 맡았다. 그는 음악을 잘 알았기 때문에 음악을 지도했다.

decisions.choice: the lifting up: the music, the lifting up of voices in song
alternatives: in charge of the carrying (of the ark)
in charge of the prophetic utterance
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "lift, carry". It can mean a load that is carried, an utterance lifted up as in a prophet's message, or the raising of the voice in song. Since Chenaniah is named among the singers in verse 27 and is "skilled", the music is the likeliest sense here. But the chapter is about carrying the ark (verses 2, 15, 26-27), and he may have directed the carrying.

decisions.choice: instructed: directed, trained the others
decisions.reason: The form is unusual. It is most likely from the verb "instruct, discipline", so he taught and directed the others; it may also be read as a form of "be chief", "he was in charge".

decisions.choice: skilled: one who understood the work
decisions.reason: The word means "understanding". In 25:7-8 it is used of trained musicians and their teachers.

decisions.choice: [of song]
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "lifting up" and supplies what is lifted, as m1 reads it. Balanced and Readable say "the music".

decisions.choice: el canto
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "lifting up" here means lifting up the voice in song; Literal says "el canto" rather than a bare "levantamiento", which would not be understood, and Balanced and Readable say "la música".

decisions.choice: "le transport [du chant]"
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb "lift, carry" and its sense here is uncertain (see the meaning decision); Literal keeps the root’s sense of carrying with the bracket of the English, Balanced and Readable say "la musique".

source.text: וּבֶֽרֶכְיָה֙ וְאֶלְקָנָ֔ה שֹׁעֲרִ֖ים לָאָרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And Berechiah and Elkanah [were] gatekeepers for the ark.

en.L: And Berechiah and Elkanah [were] gatekeepers for the ark.
en.B: Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers for the ark.
en.R: Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers who guarded the ark.

es.L: Y Berequías y Elcana [eran] porteros del arca.
es.B: Berequías y Elcana eran porteros del arca.
es.R: Berequías y Elcana eran porteros que custodiaban el arca.

fr.L: Et Bérékia et Elqana [étaient] portiers pour l’arche.
fr.B: Bérékia et Elqana étaient portiers pour l’arche.
fr.R: Bérékia et Elqana étaient des portiers qui gardaient l’arche.

sw.L: Na Berekia na Elkana [walikuwa] mabawabu wa sanduku.
sw.B: Berekia na Elkana walikuwa mabawabu wa sanduku.
sw.R: Berekia na Elkana walikuwa walinzi wa malango waliolinda sanduku.

vi.L: Bê-rê-kia và Ên-ca-na [là] người giữ cổng cho hòm.
vi.B: Bê-rê-kia và Ên-ca-na là người giữ cổng cho hòm.
vi.R: Bê-rê-kia và Ên-ca-na là những người giữ cổng canh giữ hòm.

ko.L: 그리고 베레갸와 엘가나는 궤의 문지기[였다].
ko.B: 베레갸와 엘가나는 궤를 지키는 문지기였다.
ko.R: 베레갸와 엘가나는 궤를 지키는 문지기였다.

decisions.choice: gatekeepers for the ark: guards for the ark and its tent
decisions.reason: Gatekeepers kept watch at the entrances of the sanctuary and controlled who came in (9:17-27). Here they guard the ark on its way and at its new tent.

decisions.choice: who guarded the ark
decisions.reason: Readable says what gatekeepers did for the ark.

source.text: וּשְׁבַנְיָ֡הוּ וְיֽוֹשָׁפָ֡ט וּנְתַנְאֵ֡ל וַעֲמָשַׂ֡י וּ֠זְכַרְיָהוּ וּבְנָיָ֤הוּ וֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֨זֶר֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מַחְצְרִים֙ בַּחֲצֹ֣צְר֔וֹת לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעֹבֵ֤ד אֱדֹם֙ וִֽיחִיָּ֔ה שֹׁעֲרִ֖ים לָאָרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And Shebaniah and Joshaphat and Nethanel and Amasai and Zechariah and Benaiah and Eliezer the priests blowing on the trumpets before [the] ark of the God; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah gatekeepers for the ark.

en.L: And Shebaniah and Joshaphat and Nethanel and Amasai and Zechariah and Benaiah and Eliezer, the priests, [were] blowing the trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah [were] gatekeepers for the ark.
en.B: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah and Eliezer, who were priests, were to sound the trumpets in front of the ark of God. Obed-Edom and Jehiah were gatekeepers for the ark as well.
en.R: The priests Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah and Eliezer were to blow trumpets in front of the ark of God. Obed-Edom and Jehiah were also gatekeepers who guarded the ark.

es.L: Y Sebanías y Josafat y Natanael y Amasai y Zacarías y Benaía y Eliezer, los sacerdotes, tocaban las trompetas delante del arca de Dios; y Obed-edom y Jehías [eran] porteros del arca.
es.B: Sebanías, Josafat, Natanael, Amasai, Zacarías, Benaía y Eliezer, que eran sacerdotes, debían tocar las trompetas delante del arca de Dios. Obed-edom y Jehías también eran porteros del arca.
es.R: Los sacerdotes Sebanías, Josafat, Natanael, Amasai, Zacarías, Benaía y Eliezer debían tocar trompetas delante del arca de Dios. Obed-edom y Jehías también eran porteros que custodiaban el arca.

fr.L: Et Shebania, et Yoshaphat, et Netanel, et Amasaï, et Zacharie, et Benaya, et Éliézer, les prêtres, sonnaient des trompettes devant l’arche de Dieu ; et Obed-Édom et Yehiya [étaient] portiers pour l’arche.
fr.B: Shebania, Yoshaphat, Netanel, Amasaï, Zacharie, Benaya et Éliézer, qui étaient prêtres, devaient sonner de la trompette devant l’arche de Dieu. Obed-Édom et Yehiya étaient eux aussi portiers pour l’arche.
fr.R: Les prêtres Shebania, Yoshaphat, Netanel, Amasaï, Zacharie, Benaya et Éliézer devaient sonner de la trompette devant l’arche de Dieu. Obed-Édom et Yehiya étaient aussi des portiers qui gardaient l’arche.

sw.L: Na Shebania na Yoshafati na Nethaneli na Amasai na Zekaria na Benaya na Eliezeri, makuhani, [walikuwa] wakipiga tarumbeta mbele ya sanduku la Mungu; na Obed-edomu na Yehia [walikuwa] mabawabu wa sanduku.
sw.B: Shebania, Yoshafati, Nethaneli, Amasai, Zekaria, Benaya na Eliezeri, waliokuwa makuhani, walipaswa kupiga tarumbeta mbele ya sanduku la Mungu. Obed-edomu na Yehia nao walikuwa mabawabu wa sanduku.
sw.R: Makuhani Shebania, Yoshafati, Nethaneli, Amasai, Zekaria, Benaya na Eliezeri walipaswa kupiga tarumbeta mbele ya sanduku la Mungu. Obed-edomu na Yehia nao walikuwa walinzi wa malango waliolinda sanduku.

vi.L: Sê-ba-nia, Giô-sa-phát, Nê-tha-nên, A-ma-sai, Xa-cha-ri, Bê-na-gia và Ê-li-ê-xe, các thầy tế lễ, thổi kèn trước hòm của Đức Chúa Trời; còn Ô-bết Ê-đôm và Giê-hi-gia [là] người giữ cổng cho hòm.
vi.B: Sê-ba-nia, Giô-sa-phát, Nê-tha-nên, A-ma-sai, Xa-cha-ri, Bê-na-gia và Ê-li-ê-xe, là các thầy tế lễ, thổi kèn trước hòm của Đức Chúa Trời. Ô-bết Ê-đôm và Giê-hi-gia cũng là người giữ cổng cho hòm.
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ Sê-ba-nia, Giô-sa-phát, Nê-tha-nên, A-ma-sai, Xa-cha-ri, Bê-na-gia và Ê-li-ê-xe thổi kèn trước hòm của Đức Chúa Trời. Ô-bết Ê-đôm và Giê-hi-gia cũng là những người giữ cổng canh giữ hòm.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들 스바냐와 요사밧과 느다넬과 아마새와 스가랴와 브나야와 엘리에셀은 하나님의 궤 앞에서 나팔을 불고 [있었다]. 그리고 오벳에돔과 여히야는 궤의 문지기[였다].
ko.B: 제사장인 스바냐, 요사밧, 느다넬, 아마새, 스가랴, 브나야, 엘리에셀은 하나님의 궤 앞에서 나팔을 불게 되어 있었다. 오벳에돔과 여히야도 궤를 지키는 문지기였다.
ko.R: 제사장 스바냐, 요사밧, 느다넬, 아마새, 스가랴, 브나야, 엘리에셀은 하나님의 궤 앞에서 나팔을 불어야 했다. 오벳에돔과 여히야도 궤를 지키는 문지기였다.

decisions.choice: the priests blowing the trumpets
decisions.reason: The law gave the two silver trumpets to the priests, to be blown for gatherings, for battle and at festivals and offerings (Numbers 10:1-10). They were different from the ram's horn of verse 28.

decisions.choice: blowing the trumpets: the verb is spelled two ways
decisions.reason: The letters written in the text and the reading noted in the margin of the Hebrew Bible give two spellings of the verb "blow trumpets". Both mean the same.

decisions.choice: Obed-Edom and Jehiah: a second pair of gatekeepers
decisions.reason: Jehiah may be the Jeiel named with Obed-Edom in verses 18 and 21, under another form of the name, but the text does not say.

decisions.choice: as well (Balanced); also (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "as well" or "also" to link these gatekeepers with those in verse 23. Readable says what they did, as in verse 23.

source.text: וַיְהִ֥י דָוִ֛יד וְזִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָאֲלָפִ֑ים הַהֹֽלְכִ֗ים לְֽהַעֲל֞וֹת אֶת־אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֛ה מִן־בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־אֱדֹ֖ם בְּשִׂמְחָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And it was David and [the] elders of Israel and [the] commanders of the thousands, the [ones] going to bring up [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh from [the] house of Obed-Edom with joy.

en.L: And it was David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of thousands who went to bring up the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the house of Obed-Edom with rejoicing.
en.B: So David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of thousands went to bring the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} up from the house of Obed-Edom with rejoicing.
en.R: So David, the elders of Israel and the commanders of the army's units of a thousand went with great joy to bring the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s covenant up from Obed-Edom's house.

es.L: Y fueron David y los ancianos de Israel y los jefes de millares los que fueron a subir el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de la casa de Obed-edom con alegría.
es.B: Así David, los ancianos de Israel y los jefes de millares fueron a subir con alegría el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} desde la casa de Obed-edom.
es.R: Así David, los ancianos de Israel y los comandantes de las unidades de mil soldados fueron con gran alegría a subir el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} desde la casa de Obed-edom.

fr.L: Et ce furent David et les anciens d’Israël et les chefs de milliers qui allèrent faire monter l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} de la maison d’Obed-Édom, avec joie.
fr.B: David, les anciens d’Israël et les chefs de milliers allèrent donc faire monter l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} de la maison d’Obed-Édom, dans la joie.
fr.R: Alors David, les anciens d’Israël et les officiers qui commandaient mille hommes sont allés, pleins de joie, chercher l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} chez Obed-Édom pour la faire monter.

sw.L: Basi ndio Daudi na wazee wa Israeli na makamanda wa maelfu waliokwenda kulipandisha sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka nyumba ya Obed-edomu kwa furaha.
sw.B: Basi Daudi na wazee wa Israeli na makamanda wa maelfu walikwenda kulipandisha sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka nyumbani kwa Obed-edomu kwa shangwe.
sw.R: Basi Daudi, wazee wa Israeli na makamanda wa vikosi vya watu elfu vya jeshi walikwenda kwa furaha kubwa kulipandisha sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka nyumbani kwa Obed-edomu.

vi.L: Đa-vít, các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên và các quan chỉ huy ngàn quân là những người đi rước hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm lên với sự vui mừng.
vi.B: Vậy Đa-vít, các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên và các quan chỉ huy ngàn quân đi rước hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm lên trong niềm hân hoan.
vi.R: Vậy Đa-vít, các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên và các quan chỉ huy những đơn vị một ngàn quân rất vui mừng đi rước hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} từ nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm lên.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗과 이스라엘의 장로들과 천부장들이 기쁨으로 오벳에돔의 집에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤를 메어 올리려고 갔다.
ko.B: 그래서 다윗과 이스라엘의 장로들과 천부장들은 기뻐하며 오벳에돔의 집에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤를 메어 올리러 갔다.
ko.R: 다윗과 이스라엘의 장로들과 천 명을 거느린 군대 지휘관들은 오벳에돔의 집에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤를 메어 올리려고 크게 기뻐하며 갔다.

decisions.choice: verses 25-29 retell 2 Samuel 6:12-16
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:12 says that David went after hearing how the LORD had blessed Obed-Edom's house (that blessing is told in 13:14). Chronicles names the elders and the commanders with David, says "the ark of the covenant of the LORD" for "the ark of God", and does not name the city of David here.

decisions.choice: commanders of thousands: the army's officers
decisions.reason: These were the officers over the army's large units, who had taken part in the decision to bring the ark (13:1).

decisions.choice: with rejoicing: with open celebration
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 6:12: joy shown with music, shouting and dancing (verses 28-29).

decisions.choice: the commanders of the army's units of a thousand
decisions.reason: Readable says what "commanders of thousands" were (m2), and, as Deuteronomy 10:8 does, puts the ark of the covenant as "the ark of the LORD's covenant".

decisions.choice: "주의 언약궤"
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's Korean name for the ark of the covenant, with the divine name before it.

source.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ בֶּעְזֹ֣ר הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶ֨ת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נֹשְׂאֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּזְבְּח֥וּ שִׁבְעָֽה־פָרִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when helped the God the Levites carrying [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh, and they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

en.L: And it happened, when God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, [that] they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
en.B: When God helped the Levites carrying the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, they offered seven bulls and seven rams in sacrifice.
en.R: As the Levites carried the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s covenant, God helped them, and they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando Dios ayudó a los levitas que llevaban el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, sacrificaron siete novillos y siete carneros.
es.B: Como Dios ayudó a los levitas que llevaban el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, ofrecieron en sacrificio siete novillos y siete carneros.
es.R: Mientras los levitas llevaban el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios los ayudó, y ellos sacrificaron siete novillos y siete carneros.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Dieu aida les Lévites qui portaient l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’ils sacrifièrent sept taureaux et sept béliers.
fr.B: Comme Dieu aidait les Lévites qui portaient l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, on offrit en sacrifice sept taureaux et sept béliers.
fr.R: Pendant que les Lévites portaient l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, Dieu les a aidés, et on a offert en sacrifice sept taureaux et sept béliers.

sw.L: Ikawa, Mungu alipowasaidia Walawi waliolibeba sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakatoa dhabihu ng'ombe dume saba na kondoo dume saba.
sw.B: Mungu alipowasaidia Walawi waliolibeba sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, walitoa dhabihu ya ng'ombe dume saba na kondoo dume saba.
sw.R: Walawi walipokuwa wakilibeba sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu aliwasaidia, nao wakatoa ng'ombe dume saba na kondoo dume saba kuwa dhabihu.

vi.L: Khi Đức Chúa Trời giúp đỡ người Lê-vi khiêng hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì họ dâng bảy con bò đực và bảy con chiên đực làm sinh tế.
vi.B: Vì Đức Chúa Trời giúp đỡ người Lê-vi khiêng hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nên họ dâng bảy con bò đực và bảy con chiên đực làm sinh tế.
vi.R: Khi người Lê-vi khiêng hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời giúp đỡ họ, và họ dâng bảy con bò đực và bảy con chiên đực làm sinh tế.

ko.L: 그리고 하나님께서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤를 멘 레위인들을 도우셨을 때, 그들이 수소 일곱 마리와 숫양 일곱 마리를 제물로 바쳤다.
ko.B: 하나님께서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤를 멘 레위인들을 도우시자, 그들은 수소 일곱 마리와 숫양 일곱 마리를 제물로 바쳤다.
ko.R: 레위인들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤를 메고 갈 때 하나님께서 그들을 도우셨다. 그래서 그들은 수소 일곱 마리와 숫양 일곱 마리를 제물로 바쳤다.

decisions.choice: the sacrifice on the way: compare 2 Samuel 6:13
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:13 says that when the carriers had gone six steps, David sacrificed an ox and a fattened animal. Chronicles says God helped the Levites, and "they" sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

decisions.choice: God helped the Levites: they came to no harm
decisions.reason: On the first attempt the LORD broke out against Uzzah (13:10-11). This time the ark was carried as the law required, and God kept the carriers safe; the sacrifices give thanks for it.

decisions.choice: when God helped: the time, and also the reason
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins "in" to the verb "help", which marks the time ("when") and can also give the reason ("because").

decisions.choice: seven bulls and seven rams: a full, generous offering
decisions.reason: Seven stands for completeness. Seven bulls and seven rams are offered in Job 42:8 and at the festival in Ezekiel 45:23.

decisions.choice: As the Levites carried ..., God helped them
decisions.reason: Readable starts with the carrying and joins the clauses with "and", which keeps both the sense of time and of reason (m3).

source.text: וְדָוִ֞יד מְכֻרְבָּ֣ל׀בִּמְעִ֣יל בּ֗וּץ וְכָל־הַלְוִיִּם֙ הַנֹּשְׂאִ֣ים אֶת־הָאָר֔וֹן וְהַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים וּכְנַנְיָ֛ה הַשַּׂ֥ר הַמַּשָּׂ֖א הַמְשֹֽׁרְרִ֑ים וְעַל־דָּוִ֖יד אֵפ֥וֹד בָּֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And David [was] wrapped in a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites carrying the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the chief [of] the lifting up [of] the singers; and on David [was an] ephod of linen.

en.L: And David [was] clothed in a robe of fine linen, and [so were] all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the chief of the lifting up [of song] of the singers; and on David [was] a linen ephod.
en.B: David was dressed in a robe of fine linen, and so were all the Levites carrying the ark, the singers and Chenaniah, who led the music of the singers. David also wore a linen ephod.
en.R: David was wearing a robe made of fine linen. So were all the Levites who carried the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah, the leader of the singers' music. David also wore a linen ephod, a simple garment like the ones priests wore.

es.L: Y David [iba] vestido con un manto de lino fino, y [también] todos los levitas que llevaban el arca, y los cantores, y Quenanías, jefe del canto de los cantores; y David [llevaba] sobre sí un efod de lino.
es.B: David iba vestido con un manto de lino fino, y también todos los levitas que llevaban el arca, los cantores y Quenanías, que dirigía la música de los cantores. David llevaba además un efod de lino.
es.R: David llevaba puesto un manto de lino fino. También lo llevaban todos los levitas que cargaban el arca, los cantores y Quenanías, que dirigía la música de los cantores. David llevaba además un efod de lino, una prenda sencilla como las que usaban los sacerdotes.

fr.L: Et David [était] enveloppé d’un manteau de lin fin, ainsi que tous les Lévites qui portaient l’arche, et les chantres, et Kenania, le chef du transport [du chant] des chantres ; et sur David [il y avait] un éphod de lin.
fr.B: David était vêtu d’un manteau de lin fin, ainsi que tous les Lévites qui portaient l’arche, les chanteurs et Kenania, qui dirigeait la musique des chanteurs. David portait aussi un éphod de lin.
fr.R: David portait un manteau en lin fin. Tous les Lévites qui portaient l’arche en portaient aussi, de même que les chanteurs et Kenania, le chef de la musique des chanteurs. David portait aussi un éphod de lin, un vêtement simple comme ceux que portaient les prêtres.

sw.L: Daudi [alikuwa] amevikwa joho la kitani safi, na Walawi wote waliolibeba sanduku, na waimbaji, na Kenania mkuu wa kupaza [nyimbo] za waimbaji; na juu ya Daudi [ilikuwa] efodi ya kitani.
sw.B: Daudi alikuwa amevaa joho la kitani safi, vivyo hivyo Walawi wote waliolibeba sanduku, waimbaji, na Kenania aliyeongoza muziki wa waimbaji. Daudi pia alivaa efodi ya kitani.
sw.R: Daudi alikuwa amevaa joho lililotengenezwa kwa kitani safi. Vivyo hivyo Walawi wote waliolibeba sanduku, waimbaji, na Kenania, kiongozi wa muziki wa waimbaji. Daudi alivaa pia efodi ya kitani, vazi rahisi kama lile walilovaa makuhani.

vi.L: Đa-vít khoác một áo choàng bằng vải gai mịn, [cũng vậy] tất cả người Lê-vi khiêng hòm, những người ca hát, và Kê-na-nia, người đứng đầu việc cất [tiếng hát] của những người ca hát; và trên mình Đa-vít [có] một áo ê-phót bằng vải gai.
vi.B: Đa-vít mặc áo choàng bằng vải gai mịn, tất cả người Lê-vi khiêng hòm, những người ca hát và Kê-na-nia, người điều khiển ban hát, cũng vậy. Đa-vít cũng mặc áo ê-phót bằng vải gai.
vi.R: Đa-vít mặc một áo choàng làm bằng vải gai mịn. Tất cả người Lê-vi khiêng hòm, những người ca hát và Kê-na-nia, người điều khiển ban hát, cũng mặc như vậy. Đa-vít còn mặc áo ê-phót bằng vải gai, là loại áo đơn sơ giống áo các thầy tế lễ mặc.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗은 고운 베로 [만든] 겉옷을 입고 있었고, 궤를 멘 모든 레위인과 노래하는 사람들과 노래하는 사람들의 [노래를] 높이는 일의 우두머리 그나냐도 [그러했다]. 그리고 다윗은 베 에봇을 [입고 있었다].
ko.B: 다윗은 고운 베로 만든 겉옷을 입고 있었고, 궤를 멘 모든 레위인과 노래하는 사람들과 노래하는 사람들의 음악을 이끄는 그나냐도 그러했다. 다윗은 베 에봇도 입고 있었다.
ko.R: 다윗은 고운 베로 만든 겉옷을 입고 있었다. 궤를 멘 모든 레위인과 노래하는 사람들과 노래하는 사람들의 음악을 이끄는 그나냐도 같은 옷을 입고 있었다. 다윗은 베 에봇도 입고 있었다. 에봇은 제사장들이 입던 것과 같은 간단한 옷이었다.

decisions.choice: clothed in a robe of fine linen: compare 2 Samuel 6:14
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:14 reads "David was whirling with all his strength before the LORD". Chronicles has "David was clothed in a robe of fine linen". In Hebrew the two verbs for "whirling" and "clothed" look much alike. Chronicles dresses David like the Levites around him; his dancing comes in verse 29. Both accounts end the verse with the linen ephod.

decisions.choice: clothed: wrapped
decisions.reason: The verb is found only here. It is linked with a word for a garment or cloak found in Aramaic (Daniel 3:21).

decisions.choice: fine linen and a linen ephod: the dress of those who served in worship
decisions.reason: The Levite singers wore fine linen at the temple's dedication (2 Chronicles 5:12). The linen ephod was the plain garment of those who served at the sanctuary (1 Samuel 2:18; 22:18), as in 2 Samuel 6:14.

decisions.choice: the lifting up of the singers: the music, as in verse 22
decisions.reason: The same uncertain word as in verse 22. The Hebrew is very compressed here: "the chief, the lifting up, the singers".

decisions.choice: [so were]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the words that show the Levites, singers and Chenaniah were dressed the same way.

decisions.choice: a simple garment like the ones priests wore
decisions.reason: Readable explains the ephod, as in 2 Samuel 6:14.

source.text: וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מַעֲלִים֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֔ה בִּתְרוּעָה֙ וּבְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֔ר וּבַחֲצֹצְר֖וֹת וּבִמְצִלְתָּ֑יִם מַשְׁמִעִ֕ים בִּנְבָלִ֖ים וְכִנֹּרֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And all Israel bringing up [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh with shouting and with [the] sound of [the] ram's horn and with trumpets and with cymbals, sounding aloud with harps and lyres.

en.L: And all Israel [were] bringing up the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with shouting and with the sound of the ram's horn, and with trumpets and with cymbals, sounding aloud with harps and lyres.
en.B: So all Israel brought the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} up with loud shouts of joy and the sound of the ram's horn, with trumpets and cymbals, and with the loud music of harps and lyres.
en.R: So all Israel brought the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s covenant up to the city. They shouted with joy, and the ram's horn was blown. Trumpets and cymbals sounded, and harps and lyres played loudly.

es.L: Y todo Israel subía el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} con gritos y con sonido de cuerno de carnero, y con trompetas y con címbalos, haciéndose oír con arpas y liras.
es.B: Así todo Israel subió el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} con gritos de alegría y al son del cuerno de carnero, con trompetas y címbalos, y con la música sonora de arpas y liras.
es.R: Así todo Israel subió el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a la ciudad. Gritaban de alegría, y se tocaba el cuerno de carnero. Sonaban las trompetas y los címbalos, y las arpas y las liras tocaban con fuerza.

fr.L: Et tout Israël faisait monter l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} avec des acclamations, et au son du cor, et avec des trompettes, et avec des cymbales, faisant retentir les harpes et les lyres.
fr.B: Ainsi tout Israël fit monter l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} au milieu des cris de joie et au son du cor, des trompettes et des cymbales, et au son retentissant des harpes et des lyres.
fr.R: C’est ainsi que tout Israël a fait monter l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} jusqu’à la ville. Les gens poussaient des cris de joie, et on sonnait de la corne de bélier. Les trompettes et les cymbales résonnaient, et on jouait fort de la harpe et de la lyre.

sw.L: Na Israeli wote [walikuwa] wakilipandisha sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kelele za shangwe na kwa sauti ya baragumu, na kwa tarumbeta na kwa matoazi, wakipiga kwa sauti kuu zeze na vinubi.
sw.B: Basi Israeli wote walilipandisha sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kelele kuu za shangwe na kwa sauti ya baragumu, kwa tarumbeta na matoazi, na kwa muziki mkubwa wa zeze na vinubi.
sw.R: Basi Israeli wote walilipandisha sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mpaka mjini. Walipiga kelele za furaha, na baragumu likapigwa. Tarumbeta na matoazi vikalia, na zeze na vinubi vikapigwa kwa sauti kuu.

vi.L: Cả Y-sơ-ra-ên rước hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lên với tiếng reo hò và tiếng tù và, với kèn và chập chõa, tấu vang với đàn hạc và đàn lia.
vi.B: Vậy cả Y-sơ-ra-ên rước hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lên giữa tiếng reo hò vui mừng và tiếng tù và, tiếng kèn và chập chõa, cùng tiếng đàn hạc và đàn lia vang dội.
vi.R: Vậy cả Y-sơ-ra-ên rước hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lên thành. Họ reo hò vui mừng, và tiếng tù và vang lên. Kèn và chập chõa trổi tiếng, đàn hạc và đàn lia vang dội.

ko.L: 그리고 온 이스라엘이 함성과 숫양 뿔 나팔 소리와 나팔과 심벌즈로, 비파와 수금을 크게 울리며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤를 메어 올리고 [있었다].
ko.B: 이렇게 온 이스라엘은 기쁨의 함성을 지르고 숫양 뿔 나팔을 불며, 나팔과 심벌즈를 울리고 비파와 수금을 크게 연주하면서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤를 메어 올렸다.
ko.R: 이렇게 온 이스라엘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤를 성으로 메어 올렸다. 사람들은 기뻐 소리쳤고, 숫양 뿔 나팔 소리가 울려 퍼졌다. 나팔과 심벌즈 소리가 났고, 비파와 수금이 크게 울렸다.

decisions.choice: compare 2 Samuel 6:15
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:15 has "David and all the house of Israel" bringing up "the ark of the LORD" with shouting and the ram's horn. Chronicles has "all Israel" and "the ark of the covenant of the LORD", and adds the trumpets, cymbals, harps and lyres of the musicians listed in verses 16-24.

decisions.choice: shouting: a loud shout of acclaim
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 6:15: the joyful shout that greets a king or the LORD.

decisions.choice: the ram's horn and the trumpets
decisions.reason: The ram's horn (shofar) was blown for signals and holy days; the trumpets were the priests' metal trumpets (verse 24).

decisions.choice: shouts of joy
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 6:15. Readable adds "to the city", as there, and breaks the verse into short sentences.

decisions.choice: baragumu (the ram's horn); tarumbeta (the metal trumpets)
decisions.reason: Both horns sound here, so they need two words: "baragumu" for the shofar, as in 2 Samuel 6:15, and "tarumbeta" for the priests' metal trumpets.

records.literal_gloss: And it was, [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh came to [the] city of David, and Michal [the] daughter of Saul looked down through the window and saw the king David dancing and making merry, and she despised him in her heart.

en.L: And it happened, [as] the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to the city of David, Michal the daughter of Saul looked down through the window and saw King David dancing and making merry, and she despised him in her heart.
en.B: As the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was coming into the city of David, Michal the daughter of Saul looked down from the window. She saw King David dancing and celebrating, and in her heart she despised him.
en.R: As the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s covenant was coming into the city of David, Saul's daughter Michal looked out of a window. She saw King David dancing and celebrating, and in her heart she despised him.

es.L: Y sucedió [que], cuando el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} entró en la ciudad de David, Mical la hija de Saúl miró por la ventana y vio al rey David danzando y regocijándose, y lo despreció en su corazón.
es.B: Cuando el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} entraba en la ciudad de David, Mical, la hija de Saúl, miró desde la ventana. Vio al rey David danzando y celebrando, y en su corazón lo despreció.
es.R: Cuando el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} entraba en la ciudad de David, Mical, la hija de Saúl, se asomó a una ventana. Vio al rey David bailando y celebrando, y en su corazón lo despreció.

fr.L: Et il arriva, [comme] l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} entrait dans la cité de David, que Mikal, la fille de Saül, regarda par la fenêtre et vit le roi David danser et s’égayer ; et elle le méprisa dans son cœur.
fr.B: Comme l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} entrait dans la cité de David, Mikal, la fille de Saül, regarda par la fenêtre. Elle vit le roi David danser et faire la fête, et dans son cœur elle le méprisa.
fr.R: Quand l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est entrée dans la cité de David, Mikal, la fille de Saül, regardait par une fenêtre. Elle a vu le roi David danser et faire la fête, et dans son cœur elle l’a méprisé.

sw.R: Sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilipokuwa likiingia katika mji wa Daudi, Mikali binti Sauli alichungulia dirishani. Akamwona mfalme Daudi akicheza na kushangilia, naye akamdharau moyoni mwake.

vi.L: Khi hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vào thành Đa-vít, Mi-canh con gái Sau-lơ nhìn xuống qua cửa sổ, thấy vua Đa-vít nhảy múa và vui chơi, thì trong lòng khinh bỉ ông.
vi.B: Khi hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang vào thành Đa-vít, Mi-canh con gái Sau-lơ nhìn xuống qua cửa sổ. Bà thấy vua Đa-vít nhảy múa hân hoan, và trong lòng bà khinh bỉ ông.
vi.R: Khi hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang vào thành Đa-vít, Mi-canh, con gái Sau-lơ, nhìn ra cửa sổ. Bà thấy vua Đa-vít nhảy múa vui mừng, và trong lòng bà khinh thường ông.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤가 다윗 성으로 들어올 때, 사울의 딸 미갈이 창문으로 내려다보다가 다윗 왕이 춤추며 즐거워하는 것을 보았다. 그리고 그 여자가 마음속으로 그를 업신여겼다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤가 다윗 성으로 들어올 때, 사울의 딸 미갈이 창문으로 내려다보았다. 그 여자는 다윗 왕이 춤추며 기뻐 뛰노는 것을 보고 마음속으로 그를 업신여겼다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤가 다윗 성으로 들어올 때, 사울의 딸 미갈이 창밖을 내다보았다. 미갈은 다윗 왕이 춤추며 기뻐하는 것을 보고 속으로 그를 업신여겼다.

decisions.choice: dancing and making merry: compare 2 Samuel 6:16
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:16 has David "leaping and whirling before the LORD". Chronicles uses two other verbs, "dancing" (skipping, as in Ecclesiastes 3:4) and "making merry" (the verb of 13:8 and 2 Samuel 6:5), and does not have "before the LORD". It also says "the ark of the covenant of the LORD". The rest of the verse is the same.

decisions.choice: Michal the daughter of Saul
decisions.reason: Michal was David's wife (1 Samuel 18:27). Naming her as Saul's daughter recalls the house of Saul, whose rule the LORD had turned over to David (10:13-14). Chronicles does not tell her quarrel with David (2 Samuel 6:20-23); the story goes on in 16:1.

decisions.choice: despised him: looked on him with contempt
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 6:16: she counted his behavior unworthy of a king.

decisions.choice: celebrating
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "celebrating" for "making merry". The rest follows the wording of 2 Samuel 6:16.
